integrity: The manuscript states a self-contained proof and a finite supplementary checker; no independent expert audit or formal verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp logarithmic order and an exact two-prefix contrast are proved; optimal constant, individual maxima, and general factor-frequency discrepancies are not determined. The asymptotic density 2/5 was previously established.
title: Logarithmically sharp transition discrepancy in the base-\(3/2\) Thue–Morse word
